options.content: Span metrics below are computed by Tempo's metrics generator and remote-written into Prometheus, so this page is a map to traces rather than a trace viewer. Open **Explore -> Tempo** to search spans by service and duration, or **Explore -> Tempo -> Service graph** to walk the graph; every span there links to this container's logs at the same timestamp (the `tracesToLogsV2` wiring in the Tempo datasource).

panels.title: Span rate by service
panels.description: Spans per second per instrumented service, as counted by Tempo. A service missing here emits no OTLP; it is not down.

panels.title: Span latency, p95 by service
panels.description: Histogram buckets published by the span-metrics processor. The same series exist in Mimir under the long window.

panels.title: Span errors
panels.description: Spans whose status was Error, per second. On this box the producers are the observability components themselves, so this is the bundle reporting on itself.
